#### NHC Analysis Tab

The NHC Analysis tab shows the analysis for non-hydrocarbon liquid meters. All data are mole percent values.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 603;height: 447;" />

The following items are available on this tab:

- **Effective Date** - The date for which the data is applicable. This is dependent on Contract Day, Contract Hour and Resolution. For Hourly Resolution, the effective date is the day and hour the data is effective for. For Daily Resolution, the effective date will be at the contract hour for the given day. For Monthly Resolution, the effective date will be at the contract day and hour for the given month.
- **Activity Codes** - These can be meter events, alarms, analysis changes or other items as selected on the Rollup Configuration screen. FLOWCAL calculates these at the hourly, daily, monthly, calendar and batch level. The user can choose which ones appear by going to [System Rollup Configuration](../../Settings%20Manager/System/Rollup%20Configuration.md) and enabling or disabling options in the Activity Codes section.
- **H2** - Hydrogen
- **HE** - Helium
- **N2** - Nitrogen
- **CO2** - Carbon Dioxide
- **O2** - Oxygen
- **H2S** - Hydrogen Sulfide
- **Total Sulfur**
- **Total Hydrocarbons**
- **Other Measured**
- **GMS Date** - The date when the data was written to the database

All values on this tab are displayed to the whole number. This cannot be adjusted through the Precision menu option.
